paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Coverage.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates coverage as a function of the number of completions (k). The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, employs a logarithmic scale and ranges from 20 to 28, with tick labels spaced by powers of two. The y-axis, marked “Coverage”, extends from 0.68 to 0.8, with tick labels indicating values every 0.02. The first line, represented by a dark blue solid marker, begins at approximately 0.71 and rises linearly to approximately 0.8 at k = 28. A second line, shown in light green and marked with a small green triangle, commences at approximately 0.43 and increases to approximately 0.68 at k = 28. A third line, indicated by a light blue solid marker, is plotted at approximately 0.52 at k=20 and reaches a value of approximately 0.77 at k = 28. The fourth line, represented by a light green dashed marker, starts at approximately 0.41 and steadily increases, reaching a value of approximately 0.62 at k = 28.
